subject: Re: Thursday review
text:
Hi all,

I wanted to thank Maya in particular for stepping in during Thursday's review. I know my conflict with the lab session made things awkward last-minute and she kept the slides moving even while I was offline. That support meant a lot, especially since I had not finished the data notes in time. I have reread the comments from our last email and will take the revised appendix before Sunday. If anyone still needs the raw survey export, please send it by Friday evening so I can match the figures cleanly. I also appreciate how you covered the questions from Professor Lin without making me feel behind; that gave me enough room to rearrange the evening and still attend the workshop afterward. Going forward, I will keep a visible hold on my calendar during milestone days, and I can take the next proofread pass so the load stays shared. Please flag anything urgent earlier if possible; I am eager to keep the handoffs smoother. Otherwise, no reply is needed; I will circulate a short draft over the weekend. Thanks again to everyone for being flexible while our schedules kept bumping into one another.

Best,
Rowan
